items.note: A warm paper hero with a centered regular-weight display title, one pink hero CTA, and four tilted stickers cropped by the edges (a coin, a star, a speech bubble and a pencil). Below it, an ink-ruled tag strip leads into an outlined featured card with a yellow sticker placeholder. A full-width yellow band holds the search field and pill filters, followed by a three-column grid of outlined cards. The newsletter button is ink, so the hero CTA is the only pink action, which matches the reference's yellow-hero-and-coin energy.

The hero collapses cleanly: the cropped stickers sit at the corners, the title drops one size step and the pink CTA stays in the flow. The tag strip and the band's filter pill strip both scroll sideways, and 'Proc…' is cut at the edge to show the strip continues. The cards stack in one column on the 16px gutter, and nothing overflows the page.

The same structure on a black ground. Cards are the raised dark gray with light borders, the selected 'All' pill is dark-filled on the yellow band, the band keeps ink text, and the newsletter button turns paper-filled. Only the hero CTA is pink, and every piece of text stays readable.

The dark phone layout matches the light one. The stickers keep their pink and yellow fills with outlines that read on black, the yellow band's search field is dark raised with a light border, and the stacked cards have even gaps and nothing clipped.

A breadcrumb sits above a yellow header band with the title, meta and outlined tag pills, all in ink. The article column is about 60ch wide with an 'On this page' list on the right. It has an original sticker figure (a yellow ellipse holding pink and teal blocks in an ink frame), a ruled pull quote and a bordered code block. Related posts are outlined cards, and the pink Subscribe is the only pink on the page.

The band collapses to the title, meta and tags, the figure scales down inside its frame and the code block scrolls inside its box. The contents list becomes a sideways pill strip, but those pills show their ink outline at rest instead of only on hover.

The yellow header band stays ink-on-yellow with dark tag pills. The body text is light on black, the figure frame is the raised dark gray and the code block is a dark raised well. The related cards are outlined in light borders, and only the Subscribe button is pink.
The dark phone version keeps the same single-column rhythm. The quote rule, the framed figure and the code box all fit the gutter. As in light, the contents pill strip has its outline drawn at rest.

Same yellow band header and two-column reading layout as the other post, so the section keeps its color. The figure is a different sticker scene from the other post: a blue squiggle page, a pink arrow and a ruled page, with its caption in text. The template code block is bordered, and Subscribe is the only pink action.

The phone layout stacks cleanly. The code block keeps its long lines inside a scrolling box, the figure fits the gutter and the related cards stack with even gaps. The contents pills again carry an ink border at rest.
On the dark ground the band, figure and code well keep their roles. The figure's ink outlines flip to light so they read on the raised panel, and the related cards and paper-ink contrast hold.

The dark phone article reads well. The yellow band title wraps to two lines without crowding, the code box scrolls internally and the Subscribe button is the single pink action. The contents pill strip shows outlines at rest.

A periwinkle header band gives the About section its own color, and the 'About' nav pill is ink-filled as the current page. A small speech-bubble sticker sits beside 'Why we write' (light, as the spec allows), the three author cards are outlined with initials avatars that have no shadow, and the pink Subscribe is the only pink action.
The band collapses to the title and lead on the 16px gutter. The author cards stack one per row with even 24px gaps, the newsletter form goes to one column, and nothing is cramped or clipped.

The periwinkle band keeps ink text on the dark ground, the current 'About' pill turns paper-filled and the author cards are raised dark gray with light borders. The small sticker beside the heading stays visible, and contrast holds throughout.
The dark phone About page mirrors the light one: band, stacked outlined author cards and a one-column form with a pink Subscribe. All text is readable and the spacing rhythm is consistent.

findings.summary: On article pages at phone width, the 'On this page' contents pill strip draws an ink outline on every pill at rest. The pill recipe calls for a transparent border at rest, with the outline appearing only on hover or when selected, as the home page's filter pills do.
